correctness.rationale: Adjoint zero-temperature damping sends X,Y to sqrt(q) X,Y and Z to (1-q)I+qZ with C_- = q|1><1|, q in [0,1]. For XY, dual trace witness using eigmax(aX+bY)=sqrt2 forces sqrt(q)<=1/sqrt2; H_ab=[I+a sqrt(q)X+b sqrt(q)Y]/4 is positive iff q<=1/2. For XZ and YZ any lower Z branch splits rank-one qP so 2x2 determinant positivity implies t<=(1-q)/2 and t>=(3q-1)/2, forcing q<=1/2; explicit F_a,+=[Z_++a sqrt(q)X]/2 and F_a,-=qP/2 suffice. For triple, G_ab,+= [Z_++a sqrt(q)X+b sqrt(q)Y]/4, G_ab,-=qP/4, with nonnegative determinant iff q<=1/3. Necessity: average any hypothetical parent by pi/2 rotational covariance fixing Z, producing equal qP/4 lower branch, filter positive Z_+ for q<1, leaving unbiased XY pair with sharpness sqrt(q/(1-q)); trace witness forces q<=1/3. At q=1 original XY pair already impossible. All equality endpoints handled; conclusion only Pauli triad, not channel-wide incompatibility-breaking.
